task: Given bullet points about a project, write a PM-style STAR story (Situation, Task, Action, Result) suitable for a job interview
scoring_calibration: Be strict. Reserve 9-10 only for exceptional outputs a senior PM interviewer would remember. Most outputs should score 5-7.

dimensions.name: specificity
dimensions.description: Are outputs specific with concrete examples, numbers, or named technologies? Vague generalities score low. 9-10: must include at least one concrete metric (number, %, $) AND a named technology or method. Missing either = max 6.

dimensions.name: impact_clarity
dimensions.description: Is the result/outcome clearly stated with measurable or observable impact? Fuzzy outcomes score low. 9-10: result must state a specific quantified business outcome. 'improved performance' with no number = max 5.

dimensions.name: structure
dimensions.description: Does the output follow STAR format with clear Situation, Task, Action, Result sections? 9-10: must have explicit Situation/Task/Action/Result labels or clearly delineated paragraphs. Missing structure = max 5.

dimensions.name: conciseness
dimensions.description: Is the output free of padding, filler phrases, and repetition? 9-10: under 150 words total, zero filler sentences. Over 200 words = max 5.
